summary: Comprehensive testing of SLA Subscription feature - 3-tier plans (Silver R1000, Gold R1250, Platinum R1500), admin manual-assign, Stripe checkout, subscription management. All 18 backend tests passed. All frontend UI components verified.
passed_tests: GET /api/sla/plans returns 3 plans with correct prices
Silver plan: R1000 ZAR
Gold plan: R1250 ZAR
Platinum plan: R1500 ZAR
Plans have price_display format (R1,000/month)
POST /api/sla/manual-assign (admin) creates active subscription with payment_method='manual'
Admin can assign Silver, Gold, Platinum plans
Non-admin users get 403 on manual-assign
Invalid plan_id returns 400
POST /api/sla/subscribe creates Stripe checkout session with URL + session_id
Stripe checkout URL contains stripe.com
Session ID starts with 'cs_'
GET /api/sla/subscriptions - admin sees all subscriptions
GET /api/sla/subscriptions - store staff sees only own store
PUT /api/sla/subscriptions/{id}?status=cancelled - admin can cancel
Non-admin gets 403 on subscription update
GET /api/sla/payments - admin can view payment history
Non-admin gets 403 on payments endpoint
Frontend: SLA page shows 3 plan cards with correct prices
Frontend: SLA nav item in bottom navigation bar

Frontend: Modal closes after successful assignment
Frontend: Subscriptions list shows 6 items with status and payment method
